spec: See include/kvm_ops_gpt.def (sample) and the sample reference in tests/gpu_ops/test_ops.cu. Philox4x32-10: counter=(row,ctr,0,0) uint32, key=(seed,0x9E3779B9); rounds: p0=0xD2511F53*c0, p1=0xCD9E8D57*c2 (64-bit products); c=(hi(p1)^c1^k0, lo(p1), hi(p0)^c3^k1, lo(p0)); k0+=0x9E3779B9, k1+=0xBB67AE85; 10 rounds. u=float32(out0>>8)*2^-24. temp<=0: argmax, lowest index on ties. Else mx=max logit; topk in (0,V): threshold = topk-th largest logit, candidates = logits >= threshold (ties kept), else all; w_j=exp(double(float32(x_j-mx))/double(temp)) for candidates; Z=sum w (index order, double); target=double(u)*Z; token = first candidate j whose inclusive prefix sum of w (index order) is > target, else the last candidate.
